body:
Post-merge review feedback on #683 (P2), verified still present on `main`.

## Problem

The streamed-read path claims to move the flat chunk map into the reader task, but it actually deep-clones it on every flat-object GET — the primary read path.

`crates/server/src/lib.rs:377` (in `get_object_streaming`):

```rust
// `into_owned`, not a deep copy: the resolver hands back a `Cow`, so a flat map on a
// live snapshot moves its chunk list (and every placement vector in it) into the
// reader task instead of being cloned on the primary read path (#648 follow-up
// `bbdb7c5`, preserved through the resolver seam).
let chunk_map = resolved.chunks.into_owned();
```

The comment is wrong. For a flat map, `resolve_chunk_map` returns the chunks as `Cow::Borrowed` (`crates/core/src/metadata.rs:2505`, `:2546`), borrowing from the caller's `InodeRecord`. `Cow::Borrowed::into_owned()` clones — every `ChunkRef` and its placement vector.

Before #683, this path used `inode.chunk_map.into_flat()`, which genuinely moved the owned list (#648 follow-up `bbdb7c5`). #683's conflict resolution replaced it with the resolver seam and lost the move.

## Impact

Every streaming GET of a flat (non-segmented) object allocates and copies the full chunk map. Avoidable allocation and CPU on the hottest read path. Correctness is unaffected.

## Fix direction

Have the caller give up ownership of the record so the flat path can return `Cow::Owned` (or move the list out of the resolved record when the resolve did not restart), instead of borrowing and cloning. The same `into_owned()` pattern at `crates/server/src/lib.rs:446` (the non-streaming path, if applicable) should be checked at the same time.

## Origin

Codex post-merge review on #683: https://github.com/getwyrd/wyrd/pull/683#discussion_r3699007818 — "Move the flat chunk list instead of cloning it" (P2). The other post-merge annotations on #683 (CodeQL "hard-coded nonce" hits in test files) are false positives already dismissed on the PR.
